verdict.rationale: The evidence shows IP India publishes its statutory First Schedule of official fees, with amounts by filing mode, on the Forms & Official Fees page. Nothing in the pack documents filing deadlines or a penalty, late-fee or interest schedule with exact figures. A general fee schedule is related to this story but is a different capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures
